sources.finding: Rust workspace version 0.20.0 with crates runner-app, runner-cli, runner-core, runner-daemon, runner-terminal; vendored dependencies under vendor/.

sources.title: Install Runner
sources.locator: Download the app table; Set up an agent
sources.finding: macOS 12+, Windows 10 1809+ x64, Linux beta (glibc 2.35+, ARM64 and x86_64); agent CLIs provide their own model connection and accounts; first-run Setup detects agents.

sources.title: Supported agents
sources.locator: Install and sign in; Capabilities; Launch options
sources.finding: Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity CLI, pi, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode v2 and opt-in TRAE; separately installed CLIs keep native TUI; per-agent capability table; Bypass defaults off for chats; missions use broad access.

sources.title: CLI reference
sources.locator: Command overview
sources.finding: runner commands: remote, daemon, status, project, role, crew, mission (start, stop, resume, feed, answer, link), chat start, session (list, stop, resume, restart), msg; --json output; works with app closed.

sources.title: Drive Runner from agents
sources.locator: Discover the installed version; Start and follow a crew
sources.finding: Installs a Runner skill for detected agents so an agent can start missions, follow the feed and message members; missions started from a chat link back and report.

sources.title: Missions
sources.locator: Goal and membership; Feed; Linked chat and reports; Permissions; Stop, resume and archive
sources.finding: Mission = goal, per-member terminals, persistent feed; states Needs you/Failed/Interrupted/Working/Settled/Ended; shared directory, no branches or worktrees; mission launches use broad-access permissions; stop, resume, restart slot, archive.

sources.title: Crews
sources.locator: Slots; Team conventions
sources.finding: Reusable teams of role slots with unique handles, per-slot agent/model/effort overrides and shared team conventions; starter Pair coding crew.

sources.title: Sessions
sources.locator: Read the state; Choose the right action
sources.finding: A session is one agent or shell in a real terminal; hooks or terminal activity report state; stop, resume, restart actions.

sources.title: Chats and windows
sources.locator: Files view; Changes; Notifications
sources.finding: Side panel Files with git status and worktree picker, read-only Changes view with per-file diffs and mark-viewed, desktop notifications, split tabs and windows.

sources.title: Remote access
sources.locator: Sign in; Through Runner relay; PIN pairing
sources.finding: Private beta, invite-only, mainland China; hosted relay with end-to-end encrypted sessions and PIN pairing; signed-out Runner works locally only; remote access never stops sessions.

sources.title: Claude Code accounts
sources.locator: Add an account; Switch the active account
sources.finding: Multiple Claude Code sign-ins in separate config folders with a usage popover showing weekly usage.

sources.title: MCP servers and skills
sources.locator: MCP servers; Skills
sources.finding: Settings pages list and toggle each agent own MCP servers and skills, editing the native config for new sessions.

sources.title: Build a crew
sources.locator: working directories note
sources.finding: Runner does not isolate working directories automatically; create a Git worktree before launch if needed.

sources.title: First mission
sources.locator: directory note
sources.finding: Runner starts the crew in the directory given and does not create an isolated copy or Git worktree.

sources.title: Architecture
sources.locator: Overview; usage module; agent updates; mission inbox
sources.finding: Three-process model: GPUI app, runnerd daemon (SQLite, session manager, event bus) and runner CLI over runnerd.sock; sessions survive app quit; usage module reads Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity limits; Claude/Codex update checks disabled inside sessions.

sources.title: Process model
sources.locator: runnerd lifecycle
sources.finding: Daemon keeps running without clients; Ask/Keep/Stop on app quit; app crash leaves daemon sessions running; daemon crash closes PTYs on macOS and kills sessions.

sources.finding: Site banner: Runner for iPhone and remote access are in private beta with an iPhone waitlist; links to Docs and Release notes; no pricing page (404).

sources.title: Runner Linux packages and optional runnerd user service
sources.locator: Optional systemd user service (lines 92-107); docs/guide/guides/troubleshooting.md Linux local builds (line 76); packaging/linux/runnerd.service
sources.finding: Linux packages ship runner, runnerd and runner-app plus an optional systemd user service for runnerd; troubleshooting says that if the CLI is used over SSH, start runnerd with systemctl --user first. This documents running the daemon and CLI on a Linux host reached over SSH, but no guide presents remote or server execution as a supported workflow.
